newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 14.
newsitem.headline: EARLY AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 14.

text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Lennart Meri will go on a official visit to Hungary and Slovenia in the middle of May. A business delegation will accompany Meri.
-The parliament will vote on Wednesday on whether to ratifity the abolition of the death penalty as part of their obligations to the Council of Europe.
